mapper.select: SELECT sw.student_id as "studentId", cce.coach_id as "coachId", cce.course_id as "courseId", sw.user_course_package_id as "userCoursePackageId", cce.id as "sessionEventId", cce.title as "title", cce.start_ts::timestamp as "startTs", cce.end_ts::timestamp as "endTs", cce.capacity as "capacity", cce.booked_count as "bookedCount", sw.position as "waitlistPosition", sw.created_at::timestamp as "waitlistCreatedAt" FROM public.session_waitlist sw JOIN public.coach_calendar_event cce ON cce.id = sw.event_id WHERE cce.kind = 'session' AND sw.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY cce.start_ts ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.session_waitlist WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
